maparthelper.config.common.description.l:
Every time it prints to the log file how many seconds the full image processing took.
§cIt is not recommended to leave this enabled for a long time to avoid excessive spam
maparthelper.config.common.previewHighli: Highlight colors on preview when hovering
maparthelper.config.common.description.p: If disabled, colors on the preview will only be highlighted when selected in the material list
maparthelper.config.common.description.c:
The cache is used to speed up color adaptation. The lifetime allows the cache to be reused across multiple image update iterations.
§cDo not set this value too high, or it will waste memory
maparthelper.config.common.description.d: Displayed among the staircase styles. In this mode, all in-game colors are used without considering whether they can be reproduced in the game world. Schematic creation is not possible in this mode
maparthelper.config.common.description.m: Speeds up image conversion by using multiple cores. This option has no effect when selected an error diffusion dithering (Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson, etc.), because it can't be effectively improved this way
maparthelper.config.paletteGenerator.reg: Warning: saving changes to this configuration will automatically trigger palette regeneration. This may require entering any world or server
maparthelper.config.paletteGenerator.hea: This configuration screen determines which blocks will be used to generate the palette, which can then be used to more conveniently configure custom presets in the editor
maparthelper.config.description.paletteG:
§cDo not use this setting to generate a working palette.§r
This setting is intended purely for informational purposes. Many of the blocks have impossible or short-lived states
Blocks with models or inventories: chests, banners, skulls, signs, hoppers, furnaces, etc.
Building blocks that are more suitable for decoration than for use in maparts: fences, fence gates, walls, banners, stairs, trapdoors, lanterns, end rods
Besides often requiring additional conditions to be placed, saplings, bamboo, sugar cane, vines, and other blocks may create other blocks, which is highly likely to ruin colors on the map
Simply unstable blocks that you are unlikely to want to use
